summary: Tested all 7 Human Coach Service API endpoints. All endpoints working correctly: welcome, memory, emotional-state, curriculum, surface-memory, mistake-response, and session-summary. The Human Coach Service combines Socratic Engine with Emotional Intelligence Layer, Progressive Curriculum System, and Memory Surfacing. One bug found: missing input validation causes 500 error.

minor.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error when 'fen' parameter is empty or missing. Should validate input and return 400/422 with helpful error message instead.
minor.root_cause: chess.Board(fen) raises ValueError('empty fen') in socratic_engine.py:_analyze_discovery_target(). No input validation before this call.
minor.recommended_fix: Add input validation in get_socratic_mistake_response() to check for required fields (fen, move_played, best_move) before calling create_socratic_dialogue()

action_items: Add input validation in /api/coach/human-coach/mistake-response to return 400/422 when 'fen' is empty instead of 500 Internal Server Error
seed_data_creation: N/A - Used existing dev user via /api/auth/dev-login
context_for_next_testing_agent: Human Coach Service API is fully tested. All 7 endpoints validated: welcome (personalized with memory), memory (coach's memory of player), emotional-state (detects frustrated/confident/tilted/rushed/uncertain states), curriculum (weekly training plan), surface-memory (recalls relevant past sessions), mistake-response (Socratic questioning with emotional adaptation), session-summary (end-of-session summary with progress tracking). One bug to fix: missing input validation in mistake-response endpoint causes 500 error when fen is empty.

backend: GET /api/coach/human-coach/welcome - Personalized welcome message with memory
GET /api/coach/human-coach/memory - Full coach memory of player (sessions, results, weaknesses, concepts)
POST /api/coach/human-coach/emotional-state - Detects emotional states (frustrated, confident, tilted, rushed, uncertain)
GET /api/coach/human-coach/curriculum - Weekly training plan with exercises and targets
POST /api/coach/human-coach/surface-memory - Surfaces relevant memories based on current context
POST /api/coach/human-coach/mistake-response - Socratic mistake response with emotional adaptation
POST /api/coach/human-coach/session-summary - End-of-session summary with memory connection
